items.prompt: Why can a numerically accurate DCF still give a misleading value for a real instrument?
items.modelAnswer: Cash-flow uncertainty/default/recovery,currency,valuation date,curve/collateral/funding,day-count/calendar and contingent-payoff assumptions may not match. Need source-grounded inputs and a suitable pricing framework;formula/precision alone does not establish fit or investment merit.

criteria.text: Does not infer model validity from numeric precision.
